ADAM Audio S Series quick start guide (it names the S3H in its title; downloaded and read as text 2026-11-12): "In addition to a standard IEC mains connector, the simple S Series rear panel features traditional AES XLR analog inputs and AES3 digital Input and Thru connectors [for multi-channel arrays] ... a USB jack for software upgrades", the diagram labels XLR analog input, AES 3 In, AES 3 Out, USB jack, IEC mains connector. Modelled: the four audio and mains connectors (the USB jack is a control and upgrade port whose connector type is not printed: not modelled). The IEC inlet type is not named beyond "standard IEC": the plan row carries assumedConnectors power-in. XLR genders follow the convention (inputs female, thru male). The S3H page lists 280 x 585 x 380 mm (H x W x D), 26.6 kg, two 7 in woofers, a 4 in midrange and an S-ART ribbon tweeter "optimally configured for use horizontally", rounded edges (radius 8 mm is our estimate). The `power` switch is the simulator power control. Positions are guesses.
ADAM Audio S3H page read 2026-11-12: 280 x 585 x 380 mm (H x W x D), 26.6 kg, drivers as above, 550 W maximum power consumption.
